brief: Data engineering for solo founders — 6 tools that run a real warehouse.

slots.tagline: Ingests and transforms data across APIs without writing boilerplate code.
slots.f1Body: Build ETL logic with a node-based canvas that scales automatically.
slots.f2Body: Run pipelines on schedule or event with native cron and hooks.
slots.f3Body: Built-in retry logic keeps warehouse loads reliable around the clock.

slots.tagline: Postgres-powered warehouse with real-time APIs and row-level security built in.
slots.f1Body: Handles terabyte-scale analytics with full SQL compatibility and indexing.
slots.f2Body: Deploy serverless transforms close to data for sub-second latency.
slots.f3Body: Push live query results to dashboards without polling overhead.

slots.tagline: Packages dbt, Python, and CLI tools into reproducible data pipeline environments.
slots.f1Body: Same image runs locally and in production to eliminate environment drift.
slots.f2Body: Spin up transient containers for heavy transforms without crashing the host.
slots.f3Body: Orchestrate warehouse, cache, and monitoring services with one compose file.

slots.tagline: Tracks schema migrations, dbt models, and pipeline code through every iteration.
slots.f1Body: Rollback bad warehouse deploys with atomic commits and pull requests.
slots.f2Body: Automate testing and deployment of SQL changes on every push.
slots.f3Body: Peer-review transforms via diffs before they hit production tables.

slots.tagline: Generates complex SQL and Python transforms through context-aware autocomplete and chat.
slots.f1Body: Autocomplete CTEs and window functions from natural language prompts.
slots.f2Body: Ask questions across your dbt project to find stale models fast.
slots.f3Body: Rename columns and propagate changes across every dependent view automatically.

slots.tagline: Ships internal BI tools and data apps globally via edge network.
slots.f1Body: Serve dashboards from the closest node for instant query rendering.
slots.f2Body: Connect Next.js routes directly to the warehouse with zero config.
slots.f3Body: Every branch gets a live URL for stakeholder review before merge.

slots.ctaBody: Six tools. One founder. A production-grade data warehouse that ingests, transforms, and delivers insights without the enterprise bloat.
